name: Plains Druid
summary: A far-ranging grassland guardian who runs with the wind, ambushes from cover, turns while charging, and evades danger.

features.name: Plains Traveler
features.summary: In plains terrain, add half Druid level to initiative and key exploration skills and leave no trail.

features.name: Run Like the Wind
features.summary: Gain +10 feet of lightly armored land speed and periodically run or charge at double normal speed.

features.name: Savanna Ambush
features.summary: Gain concealment and improved Stealth while prone in nature and stand during a surprise round as an immediate action.

features.name: Canny Charger
features.summary: Charge through allies and turn once, gain +4 AC against charges, and deal +4 damage with readied attacks against chargers.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: Gain Evasion while in light or no armor and carrying a light load.
